exposure: Vaginal cleansing with 1.0% chlorhexidine gluconate solution
outcome: Microbial isolate implicated in endocervical colonization
cohort: 322 pregnant women who underwent an emergency cesarean section at Alex Ekwueme Federal University Teaching Hospital, Abakaliki (AE-FUTHA)
finding: Vaginal cleansing with 1.0% chlorhexidine gluconate solution before emergency cesarean section was effective in reducing rates of post-cesarean section infectious morbidity.
